findings.title: Proof Set observation uses the cleared preparation alias instead of its surviving seal holder
findings.trigger: seal descriptor binding transfers s.proofResources into s.seal.primary.proofResources and clears s.proofResources.
findings.cause: Seal phase0 PrepareEmptyStableResourceSet constructs/clones an independent proof wrapper from base.slotResources. Binding at604-607 transfers it. Set role3 continues to inspect s.proofResources; the evaluator requires role3 absent. Thus a real surviving independently admitted wrapper and possible distinct kind/empty backing are missing. This is analogous to the manifest-holder defect already correctly fixed in this packet.
findings.correction: Observe seal.primary.proofResources at the completed transfer phase, prove cleared preparation alias and valid actual holder, include it in the fixed direct allocation-pair facts and P14/P15 or named empty-backing row. Keep absent/dual/unsupported holders incomplete; do not count a cleared alias as zero or assume proof kinds equal candidate kinds.

findings.title: Intermediate snapshot oracle equates refund receipt debt with current Owner bytes
findings.trigger: buildSnapshot yields after original RemovePendingWork debits bytes, but before shrink/reset completion clears scalar debt.
findings.cause: removeUnserialized subtracts o.bytes/o.pending before shrinkStepLocked; CompletePendingWork clears caller amount only after ResetCompletedWork. The test requires Owner.Bytes == live backing charges + full scalar debt after every not-ready return. That equality is not a valid invariant in this legal window; no executed failure is asserted here.
findings.correction: Use the exact liveBacking <= Owner.Bytes <= liveBacking+detachedDebt interval for intermediate returns, preserving terminal exact zero/debt/alias assertions and same-receipt resume. Add a targeted bounded work refusal in the debit-before-reset window so the intended distinction is tested. Do not blanket weaken unrelated pre-refund equality checks.
